names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 1. јун ст. ст., „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“, which enumerates eight names and puts him fifth. The rank words stand once at the head of the company — Свети мученик, the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types` — and nothing else in the heading is strippable, so the form is the bare personal name the heading itself prints and no fuller form exists in this source to prefer.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 910 gives it, «Иеракс Римский, мч.», with the rank word taken off; the day line itself declines the name and prints no epithet beyond this. 'иеракс римскии' has no other holder.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 июня ст. ст. — «Мчч. Иустина Философа и другого Иустина и с ними Харитона , Хариты , Евелписта , Иеракса , Пеона и Валериана (166).»

attestations.note: The day's first entry of seven, and it is one line naming EIGHT people: «Мчч. Иустина Философа и другого Иустина и с ними Харитона , Хариты , Евелписта , Иеракса , Пеона и Валериана (166).» — Justin the Philosopher, «другого Иустина», the other Justin, and then Chariton, Charito, Euelpistus, Hierax, Paion and Valerian. Eight name links stand under it, one for each, and all eight already had folders in this corpus. The year the line gives the whole company at once is 166, and the life it links, life1210, says «пострадали одновременно со святым Иустином Философом , в 166 году»; this folder's recorded 163 comes from the Охридски пролог and was NOT moved — the two sources disagree by three years and neither is preferred here. life1210's own title names the company differently from the day line: «Мученики Иустин, Харитон, Евелпист, Иеракс, Пеон, Валериан, Иуст и мученица Харита», which includes «Иуст» — Justus — whom the day line does not print and for whom no name link stands on this day. `justus-1-june` therefore took NO russian row in this batch, and the omission is a reading reported to the author rather than a decision. The passion as this source tells it: the eight were brought to Rome, imprisoned, and before the prefect Рустик confessed Christ; refusing to sacrifice they were sentenced and beheaded. azbyka.ru was not read.

Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026). doxologia's 1 iunie gave the corpus four of this company and not him; that is the Romanian day page and not a statement about him.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and prints a separate heading and a separate epigram for each of the eight, so the enumerated company is one folder per member. **He is not the corpus's Hierax, son of Terence**, who is one of the children of Terence and Neonilla kept on another day; nothing but the name is shared, and the slug carries the day because the page gives him nothing else to be told apart by. No year is given for the company, so the folder has no `dates`, and no hymn is printed.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.06.2026 (1. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, whose heading names him fifth. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE COMPANY OF EIGHT, AND ALL EIGHT HAVE FOLDERS. The heading enumerates eight names and the corpus keeps every one of them, which is why this entry is eight upgrades and no new folder: four of them stand in doxologia’s own calendar lines for 1 iunie (justin-companion-of-chariton, chariton-companion-of-justin, valerian-companion-of-justin, justus-1-june) and four were written off saint.gr, which names eight where the Romanian named four (charito, euelpistus, hierax-1-june, paion). All eight were already on the menologion 1/6 day list, so the day list alone found them and no grep was needed — the first time in this wave that has happened on a company. `sr-namesweep.mjs` scores only the first name of an enumerated company, its fourth known failure mode, so it was no use here either way. THE BODY IS FOUR SENTENCES AND IT GIVES THREE THINGS NONE OF THE OTHER TWO BOOKS GIVES: the place and the reign together („Сви пострадали у Риму за време Марка Аврелија и епарха Рустика“, naming Rusticus an епарх where doxologia makes him prefect of the city); the eparch’s one question and Justin’s answer to it, „Не мислимо него знамо“ — we do not think, we know; and A YEAR, 163, which is the first year any book read for any of these eight has printed. THE YEAR IS WRITTEN AS A `death` ON ALL EIGHT, AND IT IS A FIRST DATE FOR EVERY ONE OF THEM. „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“ is stated flat, of the whole company, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from; `basis` is `traditional`, the interval is 163 to 163, and all eight folders held `dates: null` before today. No birth, no floruit and no `locations` on any of them. `types` untouched on all eight: the heading’s Свети мученик is the `martyr` they already carry, and it is the only rank word in the heading. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

death.note: Охридски пролог for 1. јун ст. ст., of the whole enumerated company of eight: „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“. Stated flat, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from. It is the first year any book read for this folder has printed; doxologia's life gives none and saint.gr's line gives none (5 October 2026).

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего:/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь мученика Иустина Философа и иже с ним», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 1 июня ст. ст. It is the common of martyrs, printed in the plural and under no personal name, and its heading sets it over Justin the Philosopher and those with him — so it is the service of the whole company this day's first line enumerates, and it is copied whole here (BRIEF.md §4).

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings have received imperishable crowns from Thee, our God; for having Thy strength they cast down the tormentors and shattered the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers save our souls.
